summary: Light steel tower with guy wires in eastern Ontario; unstaffed from 1974; sold for scrap metal value with no date given; site today not described.

facts.design: Light steel tower with guy wires and an octagonal cupola
facts.status_note: The entry says the tower was sold to a private concern for scrap metal value, with no date. It does not say the tower was removed or that anything remains at the site.

events.note: The entry says the tower ceased to be manned as of 1974.

evidence.supports: Design: light steel tower with guys, octagonal cupola
evidence.quote: Light steel w. guys; Steel Eqpt. & A.E. Mott; octagonal cupola

evidence.supports: Location: Killaloe, Hagarty and Richards, eastern Ontario
evidence.quote: Killaloe, Hagarty and Richards, Renfrew County, Eastern Ontario, Ontario, Canada
Ceased to be manned as of 1974

evidence.supports: Tower sold to a private firm for scrap metal value, no date given
evidence.quote: Tower was sold to a private concern for scrap metal value

evidence.supports: Towerman's quarters at Jack's Lake along old Highway 62, now demolished; the only statement about the site
evidence.quote: Towerman’s quarters (now demolished) was located at Jack’s Lake along old Hwy 62

evidence.supports: Tower shown on the Department of Lands and Forests tower detection map of 1963
evidence.quote: Appears on the Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map (1963)

evidence.supports: Tower still shown on the 1996 third edition of Pembroke topographic map 31F
evidence.quote: Still appears on Pembroke topographic map 31F, 3rd ed., 1996

notes_for_editor: Single source: a user-submitted entry on firelookout.ca. Its Year Built field is blank, so the story gives no build date. The status is 'unknown', not 'gone': the entry gives the scrap sale with no date and does not say the structure was removed. The entry spells the township 'Richard's Twp.'; the story uses 'Richards Township'. The 1963 map and 1996 topo references are the entry's own citations; neither map was read. Agency is not stated, so none is given. No photos found.
